<!-- All news items below this line -->{{Current events|year=2004|month=01|day=13|content=

* [[Israeli-Palestinian Conflict]]: [[Tom Hurndall]], a British peace activist with the [[International Solidarity Movement]], dies after being shot in the head by an Israeli soldier on April 11, 2003. The Israeli government say that they may consider bringing [[manslaughter]] charges against the soldier; the man's family claim that he should be tried for murder.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://news.bbc.co.uk/1/hi/uk/3394899.stm|title=BBC NEWS - UK - Shot British peace activist dies|publisher=|accessdate=22 December 2015}}</ref>
* [[Education in Greece]]: Debate over the private universities issue and [[George Papandreou, junior]]'s suggestions (see 9 January) between [[New Democracy (Greece)|New Democracy]] and [[Panhellenic Socialist Movement|PASOK]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.in.gr/news/article.asp?lngEntityID=508624|title=Σε επίπεδο ευρωβουλευτών η κόντρα ΠΑΣΟΚ - ΝΔ για τα μη κρατικά πανεπιστήμια|work=In.gr|accessdate=22 December 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181216163409/https://www.in.gr/news/article.asp/?lngEntityID=508624|archive-date=16 December 2018|url-status=dead}}</ref> (Greek)
* The [[Constitutional Court (Italy)|Constitutional Court]] of Italy strikes down a law enacted to give Prime Minister [[Silvio Berlusconi]] immunity from [[prosecution]] while in office.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://news.bbc.co.uk/1/hi/world/europe/3392973.stm|title=BBC NEWS - Europe - Berlusconi to face renewed trial|publisher=|accessdate=22 December 2015}}</ref>
* British [[serial killer]] Dr [[Harold Shipman]] is found dead in his cell.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://news.bbc.co.uk/1/hi/uk/3391871.stm|title=BBC NEWS - UK - Harold Shipman found dead in cell|publisher=|accessdate=22 December 2015}}</ref>
* The [[Bichard Inquiry]] into events preceding the [[Soham murders]] formally opens<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.bichardinquiry.org.uk/|title=Reasons for property valuation - Real Estate information|publisher=|accessdate=22 December 2015}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://news.bbc.co.uk/1/hi/uk/3391433.stm|title=BBC NEWS - UK - 'Tough' Huntley inquiry pledged|publisher=|accessdate=22 December 2015}}</ref>
* [[American occupation of Iraq|Occupation of Iraq]]: A United States Army] [[AH-64 Apache]] attack helicopter is shot down near the central Iraqi town of Habbaniya, but is able to land without casualties.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://news.bbc.co.uk/1/hi/world/middle_east/3392211.stm|title=BBC NEWS - Middle East - US attack helicopter down in Iraq|publisher=|accessdate=22 December 2015}}</ref>
* A [[Yakovlev Yak-40|Yak-40]] [[airliner]] en route from [[Termez]] in [[Uzbekistan]] crashes near the capital [[Tashkent]], killing all 37 crew and passengers, including the [[United Nations|U.N.]]'s top official in the country, Richard Conroy.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/asia-pacific/3393845.stm|title=BBC NEWS - Asia-Pacific - Dozens die in Uzbek plane crash|publisher=|accessdate=22 December 2015}}</ref>
* [[Robin Cook]] says that the [[British Museum]]'s [[Elgin Marbles|Parthenon Marbles]] must be returned to Greece.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.in.gr/news/article.asp?lngEntityID=508606|title=Τα Μάρμαρα πρέπει να επιστρέψουν στην Αθήνα, δηλώνει ο Ρόμπιν Κουκ|work=In.gr|accessdate=22 December 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181216163353/https://www.in.gr/news/article.asp/?lngEntityID=508606|archive-date=16 December 2018|url-status=dead}}</ref> (Greek),<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.mpa.gr/article.html?doc_id=427404 |title=Archived copy |access-date=2017-09-18 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181215223836/http://www.mpa.gr/article.html?doc_id=427404 |archive-date=2018-12-15 |url-status=dead }}</ref> (English),<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.greece.gr/CULTURE/CulturalHeritage/marbles.stm |title=Archived copy |access-date=2017-09-18 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20060528065135/http://www1.greece.gr/CULTURE/CulturalHeritage/marbles.stm |archive-date=2006-05-28 |url-status=dead }}</ref> (Background, English)
